subject: Migration mode selection follow-up — Deployment options for Aurora Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Migration mode selection follow-up — Deployment options for Aurora Health

Hi Jane — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery + next steps below.

Recap (what we heard)
- Current setup: Aurora uses OpenAI-hosted endpoints for non-PHI use-cases and a small legacy GPU cluster in-house for PHI processing.
- Key constraints: PHI data must remain on-prem / within your VPC for regulatory reasons; low-latency inference for clinical workflows is a priority.
- Timeline: evaluating options now, pilot in Q1 2027, production rollout by mid-2027.

Deployment options we discussed
1) Hosted API — fastest to test, but not acceptable for PHI workloads unless token-level controls + BAA + private network options are in place.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pool (SLA-backed) in our cloud tenancy; good middle ground for predictable throughput and some data isolation (can be restricted by routing policies).
3) Private VPC / On‑prem — full isolation (VPC peering or on-prem appliance) and recommended for PHI/regulated workloads. Support for air-gapped on-prem installs is available via our Private offering.

Attachments I’m including: 1) Redwood deployment matrix (high-level tradeoffs & recommended starting points) 2) SOC 2 summary.

Suggested next steps
- Tech deep dive (30–45m): goal = confirm network/connectivity, auth/KMS needs, and sizing. Proposed times: Thu 2026-11-05 10:00 AM ET or Fri 2026-11-06 2:00 PM ET.
- I’ll share a sizing workbook you can fill with typical QPS/seq lengths so we can recommend Dedicated node counts or on-prem GPU profile.
- Procurement intro: add any pricing/contract questions to procurement@aurorahealth.com and we’ll loop in our contracts team.

If it helps, we can map a staged migration: pilot on Dedicated (non-PHI) while enabling Private for PHI in parallel — reduces risk and gives you a path to full isolation.

Thanks — I’ll await confirmation for the tech sync slot.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-deployment-matrix.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@aurorahealth.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Migration mode selection follow-up — Deployment options for Aurora Health

Thanks Marissa — very helpful summary. A couple quick clarifications: 

- For PHI workloads we will need Private (VPC/on-prem) as the default. We are open to evaluating Dedicated capacity as an interim approach for non-PHI traffic, but PHI must never leave our network.
- Data residency: must run in us-east-1 for latency and compliance reasons — is Private available in that region or would that be handled on-prem?
- Cost: can you provide a ballpark for Dedicated (monthly committed) vs on-prem perpetual license + support? If you can give a T-shirt estimate ahead of the tech sync that would help procurement.

Tech sync: Thu 2026-11-05 at 10:00 AM ET works for me. Please send calendar invite.

Best,
Jane
CTO | Aurora Health
jane.smith@aurorahealth.com

Agenda (30–45m)
- 5m: Introductions and goals for pilot
- 10m: Network & security requirements (VPC peering, egress controls, KMS/HSM) — Dev to lead
- 10m: Sizing and throughput expectations (we’ll fill the workbook live)
- 10m: Delivery options & timeline (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) + contract/BAA cadence
- 5m: Action items and next steps

Attached: aurora-sizing-workbook.xlsx and the deployment matrix sent earlier for reference. I’ll bring Dylan and Dev to cover Dedicated sizing and on‑prem installation details.

See you Thursday — invite includes Zoom link.

Dylan / Dev — quick internal notes following Jane’s reply and the scheduled tech sync.

Notes:
- They require PHI to stay on-prem / in VPC. Likely outcome: Private for PHI; Dedicated for non-PHI pilot.
- Region: us-east-1 preference for latency, but confirm if Private can be hosted in their us-east-1 VPC or we need on‑prem image.
- Procurement asked for ballpark pricing ahead of the call. Dylan, can you draft a monthly committed estimate for Dedicated (3 node, 8x A100-class equiv) and a T-shirt for on-prem (license + 1yr support)?
- Dev, please confirm feasibility for air-gapped on‑prem install and list ports and KMS requirements we’ll need to capture in the tech call.

Action items:
- Dylan: pricing deck + example commitment SOW (today COB).
- Dev: runbook checklist for on‑prem/air-gapped install + KMS integration details (EOD Thu).
- Marissa (me): send meeting invite + sizing workbook (done) and follow up with procurement on contract cadence.

I’ll thread any updates into the call notes doc (link in HubSpot).

Thanks —
Marissa
